cards.example: Hey John! How are you doing today?

extraExamples: How are you doing? — I'm doing great, thanks for asking!
Hey! How are you doing these days?
Long time no talk — how are you doing?

cards.exampleEs: Lo siento, no entiendo lo que quieres decir.
extraExamples: I don't understand — could you explain it again?
Sorry, I don't understand your accent, could you speak slowly?
I don't understand why he left without saying goodbye.

cards.example: Excuse me, can you help me with this?
cards.exampleEs: Disculpe, ¿puede ayudarme con esto?
extraExamples: Can you help me find the exit?
Excuse me, can you help me with my luggage?
I'm new here — can you help me understand the rules?

cards.example: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?
cards.exampleEs: Disculpe, ¿cuánto cuesta esta camisa?
extraExamples: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?
How much is this per kilogram?
Do you know how much is this? There's no price tag.

cards.example: Could you tell me where is the bathroom?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Podría decirme dónde está el baño?
extraExamples: Do you know where the bathroom is?
Excuse me — where is the bathroom in this building?
I really need to know where the bathroom is!

cards.example: Hello, nice to meet you, I'm Alex.
cards.exampleEs: Hola, mucho gusto en conocerte, soy Alex.
extraExamples: It's so nice to meet you — I've heard great things!
Nice to meet you. What do you do for a living?
Nice to meet you at last — I hope we can work together.

cards.example: Goodbye, have a good day at work!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Adiós, que tengas un buen día en el trabajo!
extraExamples: Have a good day! See you tomorrow.
Take care and have a good day at school.
It was nice seeing you — have a good day!

cards.example: Oh, never mind, I found my keys.
cards.exampleEs: Oh, no importa, encontré mis llaves.
extraExamples: Never mind, I figured it out myself.
Oh never mind, it was just a small misunderstanding.
Never mind the rain — let's enjoy the day anyway!

cards.example: I'm looking for the train station.
cards.exampleEs: Estoy buscando la estación de trenes.
extraExamples: I'm looking for a bookstore near here.
I'm looking for something to wear to the party.
I'm looking for a way to improve my English.

cards.example: Could you repeat that more slowly, please?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Podrías repetir eso más despacio, por favor?
extraExamples: Could you repeat that? I missed the last part.
Sorry, could you repeat that more slowly?
I didn't catch that — could you repeat that, please?

cards.example: What do you think about this idea?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Qué opinas sobre esta idea?
extraExamples: What do you think — should we go or stay?
I like the design, what do you think?
What do you think would be the best option here?

cards.example: It doesn't matter, we can do it tomorrow.
cards.exampleEs: No importa, podemos hacerlo mañana.
extraExamples: It doesn't matter if you're late — we haven't started.
Don't worry — it doesn't matter at all.
It doesn't matter what others say, believe in yourself.

cards.example: I have to go now. See you later!
cards.exampleEs: Tengo que irme ahora. ¡Hasta luego!
extraExamples: I have to run now — see you later!
I'll be back in an hour, see you later.
Great meeting you today — see you later at dinner!

cards.example: I agree with you completely.
cards.exampleEs: Estoy completamente de acuerdo contigo.
extraExamples: I agree with you — we should wait before deciding.
I totally agree with you on this one.
I agree with you, but let me add something.

cards.example: Goodbye, take care on your trip!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Adiós, cuídate en tu viaje!
extraExamples: Goodbye, take care of yourself!
Take care on your way home — it's slippery.
It was great seeing you — take care!

cards.example: Please call me back as soon as possible.
cards.exampleEs: Por favor llámame tan pronto como sea posible.
extraExamples: I'll send you the report as soon as possible.
Could you respond as soon as possible? It's urgent.
We need to fix this as soon as possible.

cards.example: I have no idea where they went.
cards.exampleEs: No tengo idea de a dónde fueron.
extraExamples: I have no idea where I left my phone.
Honestly, I have no idea what to say.
Do you know why she's upset? — I have no idea.

cards.example: Come in and make yourself at home!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Pasa y siéntete como en tu casa!
extraExamples: Welcome to our home — make yourself at home!
Sit wherever you like — make yourself at home.
We're happy you're here — make yourself at home!

cards.example: Excuse me, what time is it now?
cards.exampleEs: Disculpe, ¿qué hora es ahora?
extraExamples: What time is it? I don't have my phone.
Excuse me, what time is it? My watch stopped.
What time is it there in New York right now?

cards.example: Thank you for the coffee. - You're welcome!
cards.exampleEs: Gracias por el café. - ¡De nada!
extraExamples: Thank you so much! — You're welcome!
You're welcome — it was my pleasure to help.
Don't thank me — you're welcome anytime!

cards.example: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
cards.exampleEs: Disculpe, ¿este asiento está ocupado?
extraExamples: Excuse me, does this bus go to the city center?
Excuse me — I think you dropped your wallet back there.
Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?

cards.example: I'm sorry for being late, there was traffic.
cards.exampleEs: Siento llegar tarde, había tráfico.
extraExamples: Good morning everyone! I'm sorry for being late — the subway was delayed.
I'm sorry for being late again, I got stuck in really bad traffic.
I'm sorry for being late, my alarm didn't go off this morning.

cards.example: Thanks for the help! - No problem at all.
cards.exampleEs: ¡Gracias por la ayuda! - No hay problema en absoluto.
extraExamples: Thanks for waiting for me! — No problem at all, I just got here.
I hope I didn't cause any inconvenience. — No problem at all!
No problem at all — I was happy to help you move your furniture.

cards.example: Hey Maria! Long time no see, how are you?
cards.exampleEs: ¡Hola María! ¡Cuánto tiempo sin verte! ¿Cómo estás?
extraExamples: Hey Carlos! Long time no see — we should catch up over coffee!
Long time no see! How have you been? I've missed our chats.
Wow, long time no see! You look great — have you been working out?

cards.example: Hey man, what's up?
cards.exampleEs: Hola amigo, ¿qué tal?
extraExamples: Hey Sarah! What's up? I haven't seen you since the party last weekend.
What's up with you lately? You seem really busy at work.
Hey man, what's up? Wanna grab some pizza and watch the game tonight?

cards.example: How are you? - I'm fine, thank you.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Cómo estás? - Estoy bien, gracias.
extraExamples: How have you been feeling? — I'm fine, thank you, just a little tired.
I heard you had a tough week — are you okay? I'm fine, thank you!
I'm fine, thank you for asking! How about you, how's your family doing?

cards.example: Could you speak slower, please? I'm learning.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Podrías hablar más despacio, por favor? Estoy aprendiendo.
extraExamples: Could you speak slower? I'm still learning English and want to understand everything.
Sorry, could you speak slower? The connection on this call is not very good.
Could you speak slower, please? I want to write down your phone number correctly.

cards.example: What does this word mean in English?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Qué significa esta palabra en inglés?
extraExamples: I saw this sign on the street — what does this mean exactly?
What does this mean in context? I've heard people say it but I'm not sure.
Sorry, what does this mean? I don't recognize this word at all.

cards.example: How do you pronounce this name?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Cómo se pronuncia este nombre?
extraExamples: How do you pronounce this? Is it with a hard or soft 'th' sound?
I want to introduce myself properly — how do you pronounce this name?
Excuse me, how do you pronounce this word? I've only read it in books.

cards.example: Can I help you? - No thanks, I'm just looking.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Puedo ayudarle? - No gracias, solo estoy mirando.
extraExamples: Can I help you find anything specific? — No thanks, I'm just looking around.
The employee asked if I needed help, but I told him I'm just looking.
I'm not buying anything today — I'm just looking to see what's new.

cards.wordEn: Can I have the check, please?
cards.example: Waiter, can I have the check, please?
cards.exampleEs: Camarero, ¿me trae la cuenta, por favor?
extraExamples: Waiter, when you get a chance, can I have the check, please?
That was delicious — can I have the check, please? We need to catch a train.
Excuse me, can I have the check, please? And could you wrap up the leftovers too?

cards.example: Where can I find an ATM around here?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Dónde puedo encontrar un cajero automático por aquí?
extraExamples: Where can I find a good place to eat around here? I'm visiting from out of town.
Excuse me — where can I find the entrance to the museum?
Where can I find bottled water and snacks? I'm going on a road trip.

cards.example: I would like to order the grilled chicken.
cards.exampleEs: Me gustaría ordenar el pollo a la parrilla.
extraExamples: Good evening, I would like to order the seafood pasta and a glass of white wine.
I would like to order a large pepperoni pizza for delivery, please.
Before we start, I would like to order some appetizers for the whole table.

cards.example: Here is twenty dollars, keep the change.
cards.exampleEs: Aquí tiene veinte dólares, quédese con el cambio.
extraExamples: Here's thirty dollars for the twenty dollar meal — keep the change!
You don't have to give me back the two dollars — keep the change.
The taxi fare was $18.50 so I handed him $20 and said keep the change.

cards.example: I must go now, I'm in a hurry.
cards.exampleEs: Debo irme ahora, tengo prisa.
extraExamples: I can't stop to chat right now — I'm in a hurry to catch my flight!
I'm in a hurry, could you recommend the fastest route to the highway?
Sorry I can't stay longer, I'm in a hurry to pick up my kid from school.

cards.example: Let me know when you arrive home safely.
cards.exampleEs: Avísame cuando llegues a casa a salvo.
extraExamples: Let me know if you change your mind about coming to the concert this Saturday.
Let me know when you're done with the report so I can review it.
Let me know what time works best for you and I'll schedule the meeting.

cards.example: Where should we eat? - It's up to you!
cards.exampleEs: ¿Dónde deberíamos comer? - ¡Tú decides!
extraExamples: Should we watch a movie or go for a walk instead? — It's up to you!
It's up to you whether we eat Mexican or Italian tonight — I love both!
I'm flexible with the travel dates — it's up to you and your work schedule.

cards.example: What time does it start? - I'm not sure.
cards.exampleEs: ¿A qué hora empieza? - No estoy seguro.
extraExamples: I'm not sure if I should accept the job offer or wait for something better.
Are you going to the party? — I'm not sure yet, I might have to work late.
I'm not sure how to use this new app, could you show me how it works?

cards.example: Let's go to the beach. - That sounds great!
cards.exampleEs: Vamos a la playa. - ¡Eso suena genial!
extraExamples: How does spending the weekend at the beach sound? — That sounds great!
I found this new coffee shop nearby, want to check it out? That sounds great!
That sounds great! I've been wanting to try sushi for the longest time.

cards.example: Good luck with your job interview today!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Buena suerte con tu entrevista de trabajo hoy!
extraExamples: Good luck with your piano recital tonight — I know you'll do amazing!
Good luck on your first day at the new job! You're going to kill it.
Good luck with the exam tomorrow! You've studied so hard for this.

cards.example: Congratulations on your graduation!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Felicitaciones por tu graduación!
extraExamples: Congratulations on getting promoted! You really deserve this opportunity.
Congratulations on your wedding day! I wish you both a lifetime of happiness.
Congratulations! I heard you just bought your first house — that's so exciting!

cards.example: You worked hard, I'm proud of you.
cards.exampleEs: Trabajaste duro, estoy orgulloso de ti.
extraExamples: You finished the marathon! I'm so proud of you for never giving up.
I'm proud of you for standing up for what you believe in, even when it's hard.
Your little sister won the spelling bee — I'm proud of you both!

cards.example: I forgot the book. - Don't worry about it.
cards.exampleEs: Olvidé el libro. - No te preocupes por eso.
extraExamples: I'm so sorry I scratched your bike. — Don't worry about it, it was old anyway.
Don't worry about it — accidents happen and it's not that big of a deal.
I think I forgot to send that email yesterday. — Don't worry about it, just send it today.

cards.example: By the way, did you call your mom today?
cards.exampleEs: Por cierto, ¿llamaste a tu mamá hoy?
extraExamples: By the way, I ran into your sister at the grocery store yesterday!
We should finalize the travel plans soon. Oh, and by the way, have you renewed your passport?
It was great seeing you! By the way, your new haircut looks amazing on you.

cards.wordEs: Para ser honesto / A decir verdad
cards.example: To be honest, I don't really like sushi.
cards.exampleEs: Para ser honesto, realmente no me gusta el sushi.
extraExamples: To be honest, I didn't really enjoy the movie that much — the plot was confusing.
To be honest with you, I think we should look for a different solution to this problem.
I know you asked for my opinion, so to be honest, I don't think that color suits you.

cards.example: In my opinion, this is the best restaurant.
cards.exampleEs: En mi opinión, este es el mejor restaurante.
extraExamples: In my opinion, learning a second language is one of the best investments you can make.
In my opinion, this restaurant has the best pizza in the entire city.
Well, in my opinion, we should postpone the trip until the weather improves.

cards.wordEs: Tengo muchas ganas de que llegue
cards.example: We travel on Friday! I'm looking forward to it.
cards.exampleEs: ¡Viajamos el viernes! Tengo muchas ganas.
extraExamples: I'm looking forward to it — I've wanted to visit Japan since I was a kid!
The conference is next week and I'm looking forward to it so much.
We're having dinner at your parents' on Sunday — I'm really looking forward to it!

cards.example: Are you ready to leave now?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Estás listo para salir ahora?
extraExamples: Are you ready? The taxi is already waiting outside for us.
Are you ready to order yet, or do you need a few more minutes with the menu?
It's almost time for the presentation to start — are you ready?

cards.example: Welcome everyone, let's get started.
cards.exampleEs: Bienvenidos a todos, comencemos.
extraExamples: Okay everyone, let's get started — we have a lot to cover in today's meeting.
Let's get started! First on the agenda is the quarterly budget review.
Welcome to cooking class! Let's get started by prepping the vegetables.

cards.example: Wait here, I'll be right back with water.
cards.exampleEs: Espera aquí, vuelvo enseguida con agua.
extraExamples: Wait here at the table, I'll be right back with our drinks.
I'll be right back — I just need to run to the restroom quickly.
Don't go anywhere! I'll be right back with the car keys.

cards.example: There's no rush, take your time.
cards.exampleEs: No hay prisa, tómate tu tiempo.
extraExamples: Take your time filling out the forms — there's no deadline for this.
You can take your time deciding which one to buy — I'll wait over here.
Take your time with the meal, we're not in any rush at all.

cards.example: Why are you upset? What happened?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Por qué estás molesto? ¿Qué pasó?
extraExamples: You're crying! What happened? Did someone hurt you?
What happened to your arm? Did you fall off your bike again?
The whole office is whispering — what happened while I was at lunch?

cards.example: We missed the flight? Are you kidding me?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Perdimos el vuelo? ¿Estás bromeando?
extraExamples: Are you kidding me? I've been waiting in this line for over an hour!
You paid $500 for those shoes? Are you kidding me?
Are you kidding me? I can't believe they canceled the concert at the last minute!

cards.example: You won first place? That's awesome!
cards.exampleEs: ¿Ganaste el primer lugar? ¡Eso es genial!
extraExamples: That's awesome! You're going to be working in the same office as your best friend.
You got front row tickets to the concert? That's awesome!
That's awesome news! Congratulations on the new baby — when is she due?

cards.example: I passed the test! I can't believe it.
cards.exampleEs: ¡Aprobé el examen! No puedo creerlo.
extraExamples: I can't believe it — we actually won the lottery ticket we bought on a whim!
I can't believe it, you learned to play the guitar in just two months?
I can't believe it's already been a year since we graduated from college!

cards.example: Enjoy the concert and have fun tonight!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Disfruta del concierto y diviértete esta noche!
extraExamples: Have fun at your birthday party! I wish I could be there to celebrate with you.
Have fun on your date tonight! Let me know how it goes tomorrow.
Have fun hiking this weekend — watch out for bears and take lots of photos!

cards.example: Have a safe flight and safe travels!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Ten un buen vuelo y buen viaje!
extraExamples: Safe travels! Text me when you land safely so I know you're okay.
Safe travels to Europe! I can't wait to see all your Instagram photos.
Safe travels on your road trip! Drive carefully and stop to rest when you're tired.

cards.example: I heard you are sick, feel better soon!
cards.exampleEs: Escuché que estás enfermo, ¡que te mejores pronto!
extraExamples: Feel better soon! I'll drop off some soup and medicine at your place later.
I heard you caught a cold — feel better soon and get plenty of rest!
Feel better soon! The team misses you at work and we can't wait for you to come back.

cards.wordEn: I'm so glad to hear that
cards.example: You got the job? I'm so glad to hear that!
cards.exampleEs: ¿Conseguiste el trabajo? ¡Me alegra mucho saberlo!
extraExamples: You and Mike are finally engaged? I'm so glad to hear that — congratulations!
I'm so glad to hear that the surgery went well and your mom is recovering quickly.
I'm so glad to hear that you got the promotion! You've worked so hard for it.

cards.exampleEs: ¿Tenemos leche? - Déjame revisar el refrigerador.
extraExamples: Is this shirt available in medium? Let me check the stockroom for you.
Let me check if I have any cash in my wallet before we go to the cash-only restaurant.
Let me check my calendar first, then I'll get back to you about that meeting.

cards.example: Excuse me, can I try this jacket on?
cards.exampleEs: Disculpe, ¿puedo probarme esta chaqueta?
extraExamples: I love the design of this dress — can I try this on in a size small?
Excuse me, can I try this on? Where are your fitting rooms located?
These shoes look really nice — can I try this on with my jeans?

cards.example: Where is the fitting room in this store?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Dónde está el probador en esta tienda?
extraExamples: Where is the fitting room? I'd like to try on a couple of these shirts.
Excuse me, could you tell me where is the fitting room in this department?
I can't find where to try these clothes on — where is the fitting room?

cards.example: Do you accept credit cards here?
cards.exampleEs: ¿Aceptan tarjetas de crédito aquí?
extraExamples: Do you accept credit cards, or is this establishment cash-only?
Before I order anything, do you accept credit cards here? I don't have any cash on me.
I was about to pay, then realized I forgot my wallet — do you accept credit cards or mobile pay?

cards.example: Can you help me? I'm lost in this city.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Puede ayudarme? Estoy perdido en esta ciudad.
extraExamples: Can you help me, please? I'm lost and my phone has no GPS signal.
I'm lost — could you tell me which direction the main train station is?
I think I'm lost. I'm trying to get back to my hotel on 5th Avenue.

cards.example: It's an emergency, call an ambulance now!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Es una emergencia, llama a una ambulancia ya!
extraExamples: He's not breathing! Someone call an ambulance immediately!
There's been a car accident on the corner — call an ambulance right now!
Call an ambulance! I think my grandfather is having a heart attack!

cards.example: You look worried, is everything okay?
cards.exampleEs: Te ves preocupado, ¿está todo bien?
extraExamples: You've been on the phone looking really worried — is everything okay?
Is everything okay at home? You seem really distracted during class today.
I heard there was an earthquake near your hometown — is everything okay with your family?

cards.example: Don't worry about the quiz, it's a piece of cake.
cards.exampleEs: No te preocupes por el test, es pan comido.
extraExamples: You've been studying Spanish for only three months? That's impressive — this test will be a piece of cake for you.
Don't stress about assembling the furniture — it comes with instructions and it's a piece of cake.
I thought the math exam would be hard, but honestly it was a piece of cake!

cards.example: You finally arrived! Better late than never.
cards.exampleEs: ¡Por fin llegaste! Más vale tarde que nunca.
extraExamples: I know you missed the beginning of the movie, but better late than never!
You're two hours late to the party! But hey, better late than never — grab a drink!
Better late than never! I'm just glad you could make it to the wedding after all.

cards.example: How is the new project? - So far, so good!
cards.exampleEs: ¿Cómo va el nuevo proyecto? - ¡Hasta ahora, todo bien!
extraExamples: How's your new job going two weeks in? — So far, so good! Everyone on the team is really nice.
We're halfway through the renovation. So far, so good — no major surprises yet.
How's the new diet working out? So far, so good! I've already lost three pounds.

cards.example: It's already December? Time flies!
cards.exampleEs: ¿Ya es diciembre? ¡El tiempo vuela!
extraExamples: It feels like yesterday we were freshman in college — time flies when you're having fun!
Time flies! I can't believe my baby is already starting kindergarten next week.
Wow, time flies! We've been married for twenty-five years already.

cards.example: Good luck on your show tonight, break a leg!
cards.exampleEs: ¡Buena suerte en tu presentación, muchos éxitos!
extraExamples: You're going to be amazing in the play tonight — break a leg!
Break a leg at your talent show audition! I know you can wow the judges.
Break a leg on your presentation today! You've practiced it so many times.

cards.example: I worked twelve hours today, I'm exhausted.
cards.exampleEs: Trabajé doce horas hoy, estoy agotado.
extraExamples: I've been taking care of three sick kids all week — I'm exhausted!
I'm exhausted after that 10K run this morning. I think I need a nap.
Let's not go out tonight — I worked a 12-hour shift and I'm absolutely exhausted.

cards.example: Let's find a restaurant, I'm starving.
cards.exampleEs: Busquemos un restaurante, me muero de hambre.
extraExamples: We haven't eaten since breakfast and it's already 4 PM — I'm starving!
I'm starving! Is there anywhere we can grab a quick bite to eat around here?
I'm so starving I could eat an entire pizza by myself right now.

cards.example: Wear a heavy coat, it's freezing outside.
cards.exampleEs: Usa un abrigo grueso, hace un frío tremendo afuera.
extraExamples: Bundle up warm before you go out — it's freezing outside and the wind is brutal!
It's freezing outside! I could see my breath the moment I stepped out the door.
Don't forget your gloves and scarf — it's freezing outside this morning.

cards.example: Turn on the AC, it's boiling hot today.
cards.exampleEs: Enciende el aire acondicionado, hace un calor tremendo hoy.
extraExamples: It's boiling hot in this room — can someone please turn on the air conditioner?
It's boiling hot today! Let's go to the swimming pool to cool off instead of the park.
I don't know how you can walk in this heat — it's boiling hot outside!

cards.example: The test was canceled, what a relief!
cards.exampleEs: El examen se canceló, ¡qué alivio!
extraExamples: What a relief! I thought I'd lost my passport, but it was in my other bag the whole time.
The doctor said all the tests came back normal — what a relief!
What a relief the storm passed without causing any damage to our neighborhood.

cards.example: It was great seeing you, keep in touch!
cards.exampleEs: Fue genial verte, ¡mantengámonos en contacto!
extraExamples: Now that you're moving to a different city, promise we'll keep in touch!
It was so great catching up with you — keep in touch, okay?
Here's my new email and phone number — let's definitely keep in touch!

cards.example: Don't leave yet, I'm on my way now.
cards.exampleEs: No te vayas aún, voy en camino ahora.
extraExamples: Don't order dinner without me! I'm on my way — stuck in traffic though.
I just left the office, I'm on my way to the restaurant now.
I'm on my way! I should be at your place in about 15 minutes.

cards.example: There is a crowd outside, what's going on?
cards.exampleEs: Hay una multitud afuera, ¿qué está pasando?
extraExamples: There are police cars and fire trucks everywhere on our street — what's going on?
What's going on? Why is everyone looking up at the sky like that?
I heard shouting from the apartment upstairs — do you know what's going on?

cards.wordEs: No me molesta / No me importa
cards.example: Can I open the window? - Sure, I don't mind.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Puedo abrir la ventana? - Claro, no me molesta.
extraExamples: Would you mind if we listened to something else on the radio? — I don't mind at all.
I don't mind where we eat tonight — you can pick wherever you like.
You can borrow my car if you need it — I don't mind, just bring it back with a full tank.

cards.example: I'm in a meeting, please call me later.
cards.exampleEs: Estoy en una reunión, llámame más tarde por favor.
extraExamples: I can't talk right now — I'm about to walk into a meeting. Call me later, okay?
Call me later when you're free, I want to tell you all about my crazy day!
I'm super busy with homework at the moment, can you call me later tonight?

cards.example: Are you free this weekend? Let's hang out.
cards.exampleEs: ¿Estás libre este fin de semana? Salgamos un rato.
extraExamples: Hey, let's hang out next weekend! We could go bowling or catch a movie.
Let's hang out sometime soon! I miss our random late-night conversations.
Now that we live in the same city, we should let's hang out way more often.

cards.example: The test is hard, but I'll do my best.
cards.exampleEs: El examen es difícil, pero haré lo mejor que pueda.
extraExamples: I know the competition is going to be tough, but I'll do my best!
I'm not sure if I can fix your laptop, but I'll do my best to figure it out.
I'll do my best to finish the project by Friday, even if I have to work overtime.

cards.example: Learning English takes time, don't give up!
cards.exampleEs: Aprender inglés toma tiempo, ¡no te rindas!
extraExamples: Learning to play the guitar is really frustrating right now — but don't give up!
Don't give up on your dreams just because things are difficult right now.
I know you're tired of failing, but please don't give up — you'll get there!

cards.example: Believe in yourself, you can do it!
cards.exampleEs: Cree en ti mismo, ¡tú puedes hacerlo!
extraExamples: I know the interview seems scary, but you can do it! You're more than qualified.
You've been practicing for months — you can do it! Go out there and show them what you've got.
It's a challenging hike to the top, but you can do it! The view at the summit is worth it.

cards.example: It's raining so we can't play? That's too bad.

cards.exampleEs: Unto mantequilla de maní en la tostada todas las mañanas.
extraExamples: Help me spread the word about the party this weekend.

cards.exampleEs: Alguien puede robar tus cosas si las dejas desatendidas.

cards.exampleEs: Uso cinta para pegar fotos en la nevera.

cards.exampleEs: El reloj marcará las doce en exactamente cinco minutos.
extraExamples: I strike up conversations with people when I travel alone.

cards.exampleEs: ¡Te juro que no me comí el último trozo de pastel!
extraExamples: She swears by her morning yoga routine.
They swore loyalty to each other on their wedding day.
The witness has sworn to tell the whole truth in court.

cards.example: I need to sweep the kitchen floor — there are crumbs everywhere.
cards.exampleEs: Necesito barrer el piso de la cocina — hay migas por todas partes.
extraExamples: She sweeps the patio every morning before breakfast.

cards.example: Be careful not to tear the page as you turn it.
cards.exampleEs: Ten cuidado de no rasgar la página al pasarla.
extraExamples: Kids sometimes tear wrapping paper on Christmas morning.

The old photograph has been torn in half and taped back.

cards.example: Don't throw trash on the ground — find a bin.
cards.exampleEs: No tires basura al suelo — busca un bote.
extraExamples: I throw the frisbee with my dog at the park.
He threw his old t-shirt into the donation pile.
A surprise party has been thrown for her birthday.

cards.example: I wake up naturally at around 6 AM most days.
cards.exampleEs: Me despierto naturalmente alrededor de las 6 AM la mayoría de los días.
extraExamples: The dogs wake the whole neighborhood when they bark.
She woke up in the middle of the night thirsty.
I was woken up by a loud noise outside my window.

cards.example: People weep at weddings and funerals for different reasons.
cards.exampleEs: La gente llora en bodas y funerales por diferentes razones.
extraExamples: Some movies are so sad they make me weep.
She wept tears of joy when her baby was born.

cards.example: I need to wind my old mechanical watch every morning.
cards.exampleEs: Necesito dar cuerda a mi viejo reloj mecánico todas las mañanas.
extraExamples: The roads wind beautifully through the mountain valley.
She wound the yarn into a neat little ball.
The clock has been wound and is ready to go.

cards.example: I need to withdraw cash from the ATM before we leave.
cards.exampleEs: Necesito retirar efectivo del cajero automático antes de irnos.
extraExamples: She tends to withdraw into herself after a long week.

cards.example: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.
cards.exampleEs: El agua se congela a 0 grados Celsius.

The food has been frozen properly and will keep for months.

cards.example: Wool tends to shrink if you wash it in hot water.
cards.exampleEs: La lana tiende a encogerse si la lavas con agua caliente.
extraExamples: Budget deficits shrink when the economy does well.
Her jeans shrank after she put them in the dryer.
The old building has shrunk in value over the years.

cards.example: She refused to acknowledge her mistake in front of everyone.
cards.exampleEs: Ella se negó a reconocer su error frente a todos.
extraExamples: He acknowledged the applause with a small bow of his head.
You must acknowledge that not everyone shares your point of view.
The company acknowledged the delay and offered a full refund.

cards.example: He managed to acquire a rare first edition at the old bookstore.
cards.exampleEs: Él logró adquirir una rara primera edición en la vieja librería.
extraExamples: Young children acquire language skills at an astonishing speed.
She acquired a taste for classical music from her grandfather.
Museums compete to acquire the most important works of art.

cards.example: His answer was deliberately ambiguous, leaving us all confused.
cards.exampleEs: Su respuesta fue deliberadamente ambigua, dejándonos a todos confundidos.
extraExamples: The contract language is ambiguous and could be interpreted two ways.

cards.example: Scientists analyzed the data to find a hidden statistical pattern.
cards.exampleEs: Los científicos analizaron los datos para encontrar un patrón estadístico oculto.
extraExamples: We need to analyze the root cause of this recurring problem.
The detective analyzed every clue at the crime scene carefully.
Literature students learn to analyze poems and novels in depth.

cards.example: We didn't anticipate such an overwhelming public reaction to the news.
cards.exampleEs: No anticipamos una reacción pública tan abrumadora ante la noticia.
extraExamples: Good generals always anticipate their enemy's next military move.
She anticipated his needs even before he could express them.
Investors anticipate another interest rate cut next month.

cards.example: It was apparent from her face that something terrible had happened.
cards.exampleEs: Era evidente por su rostro que algo terrible había sucedido.
extraExamples: The full extent of the damage only became apparent a week later.
In spite of his apparent indifference, he cared deeply about her.
There are three apparent advantages to this new approach we proposed.

cards.example: Jeans are not appropriate attire for such a formal business meeting.
cards.exampleEs: Los vaqueros no son vestimenta apropiada para una reunión de negocios tan formal.
extraExamples: Please select the most appropriate answer from the four given options.
An apology would be appropriate after such a disrespectful comment.
They will take appropriate legal action against anyone infringing copyright.

cards.example: Your whole argument rests on a completely false assumption about human nature.
cards.exampleEs: Todo tu argumento se basa en una suposición completamente falsa sobre la naturaleza humana.
extraExamples: We are working on the assumption that interest rates will remain stable.
Never make assumptions without first checking the actual facts.
His silent assumption was that someone else would always clean the mess.

cards.example: It was a brave attempt even though it ultimately failed completely.
cards.exampleEs: Fue un intento valiente a pesar de que finalmente fracasó por completo.
extraExamples: This is my third attempt to pass the notoriously difficult exam.
They made no attempt to escape and surrendered peacefully to police.
Her first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly actually quite good.

cards.example: She attributes her success to hard work and a little bit of luck.
cards.exampleEs: Ella atribuye su éxito al trabajo duro y a un poco de suerte.
extraExamples: Patience is one of the most valuable attributes a teacher can have.
This poem is usually attributed to the fourteenth-century poet Dante.
Researchers attribute the rise in allergies to modern air pollution.

cards.example: Regular moderate exercise is highly beneficial to cardiovascular health.
cards.exampleEs: El ejercicio moderado regular es altamente beneficioso para la salud cardiovascular.
extraExamples: The new trade agreement will be mutually beneficial for both countries.
Some insects are actually beneficial to gardens and agriculture.
A peaceful environment is beneficial to concentration and productivity.

cards.example: The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately eighty thousand people.
cards.exampleEs: El estadio tiene una capacidad de asientos de aproximadamente ochenta mil personas.
extraExamples: She has an incredible capacity for remembering people's names and faces.
The battery capacity of this new smartphone is twice the previous model.
I have no capacity to take on any more work this month, I'm sorry.

cards.example: Products are organized by category to make browsing easier for customers.
cards.exampleEs: Los productos están organizados por categoría para facilitar la navegación a los clientes.
extraExamples: Books about cooking fall under the home and lifestyle category.
This novel doesn't really fit neatly into any literary category.
Winners are chosen in five different categories by a professional jury.

cards.example: Climbing that mountain in winter was the greatest challenge of my whole life.
cards.exampleEs: Escalar esa montaña en invierno fue el mayor desafío de toda mi vida.
extraExamples: Nothing worthwhile is ever achieved without facing serious challenges.
His theory seriously challenged all established scientific beliefs.
The job will really challenge you and help you grow professionally.

cards.example: Under no circumstances should you open the door to complete strangers.
cards.exampleEs: Bajo ninguna circunstancia debes abrirle la puerta a desconocidos.
extraExamples: Given the difficult circumstances, she handled the crisis remarkably well.
A series of unfortunate circumstances ruined our carefully planned holiday.
Circumstances permitting, we'd like to visit again sometime next spring.

cards.example: Our wedding anniversary happens to coincide with Valentine's Day.
cards.exampleEs: Nuestro aniversario de bodas coincide casualmente con el Día de San Valentín.
extraExamples: His tastes in music almost perfectly coincide with mine.
The strike coincided with the busiest shopping weekend of the year.
The two clocks always coincide exactly at noon every single day.

cards.example: Marriage requires a lifelong commitment from both people involved.
cards.exampleEs: El matrimonio requiere un compromiso de por vida de ambas personas involucradas.
extraExamples: We reaffirmed our commitment to protecting the natural environment.
Her commitment to the project never wavered, even in the hardest times.
You can't expect to learn a language without real personal commitment.

cards.example: No other painter of his time produced work comparable to Van Gogh.
cards.exampleEs: Ningún otro pintor de su época produjo obras comparables a las de Van Gogh.
extraExamples: The two apartments are of comparable size but vastly different prices.
His achievements are comparable with the very best in the entire field.
We need a comparable figure from last year for an accurate comparison.

cards.example: The company will compensate you for any work-related travel expenses.
cards.exampleEs: La empresa te compensará por cualquier gasto de viaje relacionado con el trabajo.
extraExamples: Nothing on earth can compensate for the loss of a beloved child.
He tried to compensate for his lateness by bringing her some flowers.
The factory workers were generously compensated for working overtime.

cards.example: The job interview is designed to assess your professional competence.
cards.exampleEs: La entrevista de trabajo está diseñada para evaluar tu competencia profesional.
extraExamples: She demonstrated great technical competence throughout the entire project.
Competence and honesty are the two traits I value most in employees.
Her competence as a surgeon is widely acknowledged across the country.

cards.example: Every decision you make will have long-term consequences for your future.
cards.exampleEs: Cada decisión que tomes tendrá consecuencias a largo plazo para tu futuro.
extraExamples: He broke the law and now must face the serious consequences of his actions.
One consequence of globalization is the rapid spread of infectious diseases.
The accident was the direct consequence of reckless and irresponsible driving.

cards.example: The project required a considerable investment of both time and money.
cards.exampleEs: El proyecto requirió una inversión considerable tanto de tiempo como de dinero.
extraExamples: There's been a considerable improvement in your English since last year.
Considerable damage was caused by the unexpected hurricane last week.
She has considerable influence over the board members' final decisions.

cards.example: He's one of our most consistent players, rarely performing below his level.
cards.exampleEs: Es uno de nuestros jugadores más constantes, rara vez rinde por debajo de su nivel.
extraExamples: Your theory needs to be consistent with all the known experimental facts.
The quality of their products has remained consistently high for decades.
Be consistent in your parenting rules or children will get confused.

cards.example: Women constitute roughly fifty percent of the country's total population.
cards.exampleEs: Las mujeres constituyen aproximadamente el cincuenta por ciento de la población total del país.
extraExamples: Failing to appear in court will constitute a breach of your bail conditions.
These twelve stories constitute the author's finest literary achievement.
What constitutes a good life remains an open philosophical question.

cards.example: She stood by the window, contemplating the snow falling on the rooftops.
cards.exampleEs: Ella se quedó junto a la ventana, contemplando la nieve caer sobre los tejados.
extraExamples: For a moment I seriously contemplated quitting and returning home.
The ancient Greeks contemplated the nature of virtue and justice.
We are still contemplating whether to accept their generous offer or not.

cards.example: Everyone is expected to contribute something to the community project.
cards.exampleEs: Se espera que todos contribuyan en algo al proyecto comunitario.
extraExamples: Regular exercise and good diet contribute to long-term overall health.

Multiple factors contributed to the dramatic collapse of the stock market.

cards.example: She finally convinced me that joining the team was the right decision.
cards.exampleEs: Ella finalmente me convenció de que unirme al equipo era la decisión correcta.
extraExamples: How do you plan to convince them of the proposal's actual merits?

cards.example: The numbered buttons correspond to the chapters of the online video course.
cards.exampleEs: Los botones numerados corresponden a los capítulos del curso de video en línea.
extraExamples: The name on the envelope doesn't correspond with the name on the door.

cards.example: It's absolutely crucial that we reach an agreement before the deadline expires.
cards.exampleEs: Es absolutamente crucial que lleguemos a un acuerdo antes de que expire el plazo.
extraExamples: Trust plays a crucial role in every healthy long-term romantic relationship.
The witness's testimony proved crucial to securing the final conviction.
Tomorrow's match is crucial — if we lose, we're definitely out of the tournament.

cards.example: He worked hard to cultivate a reputation as a serious reliable professional.
cards.exampleEs: Él trabajó duro para cultivar una reputación de profesional serio y fiable.
extraExamples: The villagers cultivate rice and corn in the fertile valley below the mountains.
Cultivate good study habits early and you'll never regret it later in life.
She deliberately cultivated friendships with the most influential people around.

cards.example: There's been a steady decline in the population of this rural town.
cards.exampleEs: Ha habido un declive constante en la población de este pueblo rural.
extraExamples: I politely declined their dinner invitation because I already had plans.

cards.example: The professor used a simple experiment to demonstrate the law of gravity.
cards.exampleEs: El profesor usó un experimento simple para demostrar la ley de la gravedad.

cards.example: She was absolutely determined to finish the marathon no matter what happened.
cards.exampleEs: Ella estaba absolutamente decidida a terminar el maratón sin importar lo que pasara.

cards.exampleEs: La empresa desarrollará una línea completamente nueva de productos de limpieza ecológicos.

cards.example: The effects of the drug gradually diminish after a few hours have passed.
cards.exampleEs: Los efectos del fármaco disminuyen gradualmente después de pasar unas horas.

cards.exampleEs: Las dos especies tienen características muy distintas que las separan claramente.

cards.exampleEs: Las especies evolucionan a lo largo de miles de generaciones a través del mecanismo de la selección natural.

cards.exampleEs: No exageres — no fue tan malo como lo estás haciendo parecer ahora.

cards.exampleEs: La empresa planea expandir sus operaciones a al menos tres nuevos mercados asiáticos.

cards.exampleEs: Los primeros exploradores partieron en barcos de madera para explorar los vastos océanos desconocidos.

cards.exampleEs: La libertad de expresión es un derecho humano fundamental que nunca debe comprometerse.

cards.exampleEs: El enorme parque eólico genera suficiente electricidad para abastecer a cincuenta mil hogares.

cards.exampleEs: Ella mostró una preocupación genuina cuando se enteró de mis graves problemas de salud.

cards.exampleEs: Aprender un idioma es un proceso gradual que simplemente no se puede apresurar.

cards.exampleEs: Estaba fuera del país; de ahí su ausencia inevitable en la reunión importante.

cards.exampleEs: Por tu propia seguridad, nunca ignores las advertencias meteorológicas oficiales durante tormentas severas.

cards.exampleEs: Las implicaciones completas de la sentencia judicial no se conocerán hasta dentro de varios años.

cards.exampleEs: El diseño revisado incorporará todas las sugerencias de los comentarios del cliente.

cards.exampleEs: Las últimas estadísticas indican que una recuperación económica gradual pero constante está en marcha.

With the heavy rain forecast, floods in the valley area are now virtually inevitable.

cards.example: Teachers have a profound long-term influence on the future lives of their students.
cards.exampleEs: Los profesores tienen una profunda influencia a largo plazo en la vida futura de sus alumnos.
extraExamples: Don't let peer pressure influence you into doing something you know is wrong.
Her mother was the single biggest creative influence in her entire life.
Many psychologists study how advertising influences consumer purchasing decisions.

cards.example: The children will inherit the family estate when both parents eventually pass away.
cards.exampleEs: Los hijos heredarán la finca familiar cuando ambos padres fallezcan eventualmente.
extraExamples: She inherited her grandmother's beautiful curly red hair and sparkling green eyes.
The new government inherited an economy in ruins after a decade of mismanagement.
Humans inherit half of their genetic material from each biological parent.

cards.example: The United Nations hoped to initiate peace talks between the warring factions.
cards.exampleEs: Las Naciones Unidas esperaban iniciar conversaciones de paz entre las facciones en guerra.
extraExamples: Anyone wishing to join the club must first initiate the membership application process.
She initiated a very ambitious fundraising campaign for the local children's hospital.
The male bird initiates an elaborate courtship ritual to attract a suitable mate.

cards.example: The young engineer won many awards for his innovative engineering designs.
cards.exampleEs: El joven ingeniero ganó muchos premios por sus diseños de ingeniería innovadores.
extraExamples: They are widely recognized as the most innovative company in the entire tech industry.
We need a truly innovative solution — not more of the same old unsuccessful ideas.
His innovative teaching methods transformed the school into a national success story.

cards.example: The documentary offers fascinating insight into the private life of the famous artist.
cards.exampleEs: El documental ofrece una visión fascinante sobre la vida privada del famoso artista.
extraExamples: She had a sudden brilliant insight that immediately solved the long-standing puzzle.
The book provides valuable insights into the psychology of human relationships.
His years of experience in the field give him unique insights into market trends.

cards.example: It takes time for recent immigrants to integrate fully into their new host society.
cards.exampleEs: Los inmigrantes recientes tardan tiempo en integrarse plenamente en su nueva sociedad de acogida.
extraExamples: The new software integrates perfectly with all your existing business applications.
Schools must integrate children with special needs into regular classrooms whenever possible.
The design integrates classical architecture with the most modern eco-friendly materials.

cards.example: The intense heat of the midday desert sun was almost unbearable for the travelers.
cards.exampleEs: El intenso calor del sol del mediodía en el desierto era casi insoportable para los viajeros.
extraExamples: There was intense competition between the two rival teams throughout the entire match.
She felt intense relief when the long difficult surgery was finally declared a success.
Intense military training builds both enormous physical strength and mental resilience.

cards.example: Children learn social skills by interacting with other children at school.
cards.exampleEs: Los niños aprenden habilidades sociales interactuando con otros niños en la escuela.
extraExamples: These two chemicals interact in surprising ways at very high temperatures.
The professor enjoys interacting directly with students outside formal classroom hours.
Modern smartphones allow users to interact with the entire world instantly.

cards.example: The poet's work has been interpreted in many different ways by literary critics.
cards.exampleEs: La obra del poeta ha sido interpretada de muchas maneras diferentes por los críticos literarios.
extraExamples: She was hired to interpret for the foreign delegates during the international summit.
How should we interpret these latest, somewhat confusing experimental results?
The dream can be interpreted as a symbol of your hidden fears and desires.

cards.example: Police are currently investigating the suspicious disappearance of the wealthy businessman.
cards.exampleEs: La policía está investigando actualmente la sospechosa desaparición del rico empresario.
extraExamples: The committee was formed to investigate allegations of fraud against senior officials.
Scientists have been investigating the mysterious phenomenon for over twenty years.
Journalists are usually the first to investigate and uncover cases of political corruption.

cards.example: The highways are maintained regularly throughout the year to guarantee road safety.
cards.exampleEs: Las autopistas se mantienen regularmente durante todo el año para garantizar la seguridad vial.
extraExamples: She maintains a strict vegetarian diet for both health and ethical reasons.
The hotel has maintained its reputation for excellence for more than a century.
Despite the many accusations, he has always maintained his complete innocence.

cards.example: The data had been deliberately manipulated to support a predetermined conclusion.
cards.exampleEs: Los datos habían sido manipulados deliberadamente para apoyar una conclusión predeterminada.
extraExamples: Advertising is designed to manipulate consumer emotions to encourage purchases.
Machinery of this complexity must be manipulated only by well-trained technicians.
He is a charismatic leader who knows how to manipulate crowds of followers.

cards.example: Great leaders are able to motivate their teams to achieve things they never thought possible.
cards.exampleEs: Los grandes líderes son capaces de motivar a sus equipos para lograr cosas que nunca pensaron posibles.
extraExamples: What motivated you to suddenly give up a well-paid corporate career and become an artist?
Good teachers motivate their students by showing genuine enthusiasm for the subject matter.
Our employees are motivated by a combination of fair pay, recognition and personal challenge.

cards.example: Union representatives will negotiate better working conditions with the company management.
cards.exampleEs: Los representantes sindicales negociarán mejores condiciones laborales con la dirección de la empresa.
extraExamples: They are currently negotiating a peace treaty to end the war that has lasted five years.
The driver skillfully negotiated the sharp icy turns of the dangerous mountain road.
You can usually negotiate the price of furniture at this kind of family-run store.

cards.example: The task was extremely difficult; nevertheless, the team somehow finished on schedule.
cards.exampleEs: La tarea fue sumamente difícil; no obstante, el equipo de alguna manera terminó a tiempo.
extraExamples: The news came as a terrible shock. Nevertheless, we knew we had to keep going forward.
He's quiet and shy. Nevertheless, he gives among the most memorable speeches I've ever heard.
The storm was terrible. Nevertheless, our small boat made it safely back to the harbor.

cards.example: You must obtain a valid work permit before you can legally accept employment in the country.
cards.exampleEs: Debes obtener un permiso de trabajo válido antes de poder aceptar legalmente un empleo en el país.
extraExamples: He obtained a copy of the original document from the national archives in Madrid.
Scientists are hoping to obtain new information from the powerful space telescope's latest images.
She obtained outstanding exam results and was accepted by every university she applied to.

cards.example: It was obvious from the very beginning that the whole proposal was completely impractical.
cards.exampleEs: Era obvio desde el principio que toda la propuesta era completamente impráctica.
extraExamples: The answer seems so obvious to me that I'm genuinely surprised nobody thought of it before.
For some reason that isn't obvious to me, she refused to speak to me at the party.
There's an almost obvious connection between smoking tobacco and certain serious lung diseases.

cards.example: The new enormous office building occupies an entire city block downtown.
cards.exampleEs: El nuevo edificio de oficinas enorme ocupa una manzana entera en el centro.
extraExamples: Work occupies most of my time during the week, leaving little for hobbies.
A large portion of the country was still under enemy military occupation.
Reading occupies every free moment of her busy but very satisfying life.

cards.example: The ongoing investigation into the scandal is not expected to conclude until next spring.
cards.exampleEs: No se espera que la investigación en curso sobre el escándalo concluya hasta la próxima primavera.
extraExamples: We are in an ongoing process of continuous improvement of all our products.
Support for the software is provided on an ongoing basis for the full warranty period.
There's an ongoing debate among economists about the long-term effects of the new policy.

cards.example: The new road runs parallel to the old railway line for about forty kilometers.
cards.exampleEs: La nueva carretera discurre paralela a la antigua línea de ferrocarril durante unos cuarenta kilómetros.
extraExamples: The book draws interesting parallels between the two historical revolutions.
The two companies are conducting parallel investigations into the same safety issue.
The career paths of the two brothers followed strangely parallel trajectories for decades.

cards.example: She perceived a note of hesitation in his voice when he answered the difficult question.
cards.exampleEs: Ella percibió un matiz de vacilación en su voz cuando respondió a la difícil pregunta.
extraExamples: The public generally perceives politicians as being dishonest and motivated mainly by self-interest.
How the human brain actually perceives color is still only partially understood by neuroscientists.
He perceived the opportunity almost before anyone else in the room had even noticed it.

cards.example: If the symptoms persist for more than three days, you should definitely consult a qualified doctor.
cards.exampleEs: Si los síntomas persisten durante más de tres días, definitivamente deberías consultar a un médico cualificado.
extraExamples: Despite the failure of his early experiments, the determined inventor persisted in his research.
The cold weather persisted well into what should have been the warm spring months.
You must persist and keep trying until you eventually achieve what you have set out to do.

cards.example: The northern lights are one of the most beautiful natural phenomena on Earth.
cards.exampleEs: Las auroras boreales son uno de los fenómenos naturales más bellos de la Tierra.
extraExamples: Social media addiction is a relatively recent psychological phenomenon affecting millions.
Scientists are still trying to fully explain the mysterious phenomenon of ball lightning.
The Beatles were an unmatched cultural phenomenon that changed the history of popular music forever.

cards.example: The project has enormous commercial potential if it's developed and marketed correctly.
cards.exampleEs: El proyecto tiene un enorme potencial comercial si se desarrolla y comercializa correctamente.
extraExamples: All children have hidden potential that simply needs to be discovered and nurtured by caring adults.
What do you think is the long-term potential of this new medical treatment?
The abandoned warehouse site has great potential for conversion into modern luxury loft apartments.

cards.example: The speech delivered a powerful attack on racial prejudice and all forms of discrimination.
cards.exampleEs: El discurso lanzó un poderoso ataque contra el prejuicio racial y todas las formas de discriminación.
extraExamples: Nobody should be denied an equal opportunity simply on the grounds of outdated prejudice.
Her experience of prejudice as a child motivated her to fight for human rights as an adult.
We must all learn to judge each person as an individual and never act on prejudice.

cards.example: It's every generation's sacred duty to preserve the world's cultural heritage for the future.
cards.exampleEs: Es el deber sagrado de cada generación preservar el patrimonio cultural del mundo para el futuro.
extraExamples: Traditionally, salt was widely used to preserve food for long winters without refrigeration.
The old national park was established to preserve the unique forest ecosystem forever.
She recorded her grandmother's stories on video to preserve the family history for future generations.

cards.example: She's a prominent lawyer who has handled several extremely high-profile legal cases.
cards.exampleEs: Ella es una abogada destacada que ha llevado varios casos legales de altísimo perfil.
extraExamples: The newspaper's prominent front-page story forced the government to issue an official response.
He occupies a very prominent position in the modern art world, curating major international exhibitions.
The most prominent feature of the landscape is the large snow-covered volcano in the distance.

cards.example: Please limit your comments to matters that are directly relevant to the topic under discussion.
cards.exampleEs: Por favor limita tus comentarios a asuntos que sean directamente relevantes para el tema en discusión.
extraExamples: Some of his books are even more relevant today than they were when first published decades ago.
Make sure you submit only work experience that is relevant to the specific position you are applying for.
Court rules strictly prevent lawyers from introducing evidence that is not directly relevant to the case.

cards.example: He was naturally reluctant to sell the beloved family home where his children had grown up.
cards.exampleEs: Naturalmente era reacio a vender la querida casa familiar donde sus hijos habían crecido.
extraExamples: She seemed reluctant at first, but eventually agreed to help us with the complicated task.
Most people are reluctant to speak publicly about their own serious personal problems.
The witness was reluctant to identify the attackers, apparently out of fear of possible retaliation.

cards.example: All the jobs advertised require at least three years of relevant professional experience.
cards.exampleEs: Todos los empleos anunciados requieren al menos tres años de experiencia profesional relevante.
extraExamples: You will be required to present a valid form of photographic ID before entering the building.
The extremely technical report requires a careful detailed reading before you can fully understand it.
True mastery of any complex skill requires many thousands of hours of deliberate practice.

cards.example: I drink coffee every single morning before work.
cards.exampleEs: Bebo café todas las mañanas antes del trabajo.
extraExamples: She works in a hospital as a pediatric nurse.
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
They usually travel to Europe once every two years.

cards.example: I am reading a very interesting book right now.
cards.exampleEs: Estoy leyendo un libro muy interesante ahora mismo.
extraExamples: She is cooking dinner in the kitchen for her family.
We are building our own house in the countryside.
They are currently discussing the new marketing strategy.

cards.example: I have visited that beautiful country three times already.
cards.exampleEs: He visitado ese hermoso país tres veces ya.
extraExamples: She has already finished her master's degree thesis.
We have lived in this neighborhood for fifteen years.
He has never tried sushi in his entire life — would you believe it?

cards.example: I have been studying English for almost six years now.
cards.exampleEs: He estado estudiando inglés durante casi seis años ya.
extraExamples: She has been working since six in the morning today.
They have been building that bridge for over three years.
We have been waiting here for more than an hour and a half.

cards.example: I went to Paris with my family two summers ago.
cards.exampleEs: Fui a París con mi familia hace dos veranos.
extraExamples: She bought a new laptop for work last Friday afternoon.
We saw a very sad movie at the cinema yesterday evening.
They lived in Japan from 2015 until very recently.

cards.example: I was taking a shower when the phone suddenly rang.
cards.exampleEs: Estaba dándome una ducha cuando el teléfono sonó de repente.
extraExamples: She was studying while her brother was playing video games.
They were walking in the park when it started to rain heavily.
We were having a lovely dinner when the power went out suddenly.

cards.example: I had already eaten dinner when my friends arrived at my house.
cards.exampleEs: Ya había cenado cuando mis amigos llegaron a mi casa.
extraExamples: She had never tasted such delicious food before her trip to Italy.
They had finished the project a week before the actual deadline.
We realized we had been to that same place ten years earlier.

cards.example: I had been working there for five years when they finally promoted me.
cards.exampleEs: Había estado trabajando allí durante cinco años cuando finalmente me ascendieron.
extraExamples: She had been waiting for over an hour when the taxi finally showed up.
They had been traveling for twenty hours before they finally reached home.
We had been searching for the keys for an hour when we found them.

cards.example: I will call you as soon as I arrive at the airport tomorrow.
cards.exampleEs: Te llamaré en cuanto llegue al aeropuerto mañana.
extraExamples: She will probably be late because of all the traffic tonight.
Don't worry — I will help you finish the report after lunch.
They will announce the winner of the contest in five minutes.

cards.example: I am going to learn how to play the guitar next year.
cards.exampleEs: Voy a aprender a tocar la guitarra el próximo año.
extraExamples: She is going to have a baby in about three months.
We are going to move to a bigger apartment next summer.
They are going to open a new restaurant downtown very soon.

cards.example: This time tomorrow I will be lying on a beach in Hawaii.
cards.exampleEs: A estas horas mañana estaré tirado en una playa en Hawái.
extraExamples: She will be giving an important presentation at ten o'clock.
We will be driving through the mountains all day Saturday.
This time next year they will be living in their brand new house.

cards.example: By the end of this year I will have finished my university degree.
cards.exampleEs: Para finales de este año habré terminado mi carrera universitaria.
extraExamples: By next month she will have worked here for exactly ten years.
When you arrive, we will have already prepared everything for you.
By 2030 they will have completed the entire construction project.
